en.headline: Election Committee receives 28 more nomination forms on day seven
en.dek: Returning officers took 25 candidate forms and three from designated bodies, bringing the cumulative totals to 1,086 and 35 respectively as the period runs to 20 October.
body: Returning officers for the 2026 Election Committee Subsector Ordinary Elections received 25 nomination forms for candidates and three from designated bodies on Wednesday, the Registration and Electoral Office said.
Since the nomination period opened on 7 October, the cumulative totals stand at 1,086 candidate nomination forms and 35 from designated bodies. The period ends on 20 October.
The forms cover various subsectors across the five sectors of the Election Committee. Particulars of the nominations received will be uploaded to the election website.
The Election Committee will select the next Chief Executive. Voting for the subsector ordinary elections is scheduled for 22 November.

zh.headline: 選委會選舉提名期第七日再接獲28份提名表格
zh.dek: 選舉主任今日接獲25份候選人提名表格及3份指定團體提名表格，累計分別為1086份及35份，提名期至10月20日結束。
body: 選舉事務處表示，2026年選舉委員會界別分組一般選舉的選舉主任今日（14日）共接獲25份候選人提名表格及3份指定團體提名表格。
自提名期由10月7日開始，至今累計接獲1086份候選人提名表格及35份指定團體提名表格。提名期將於10月20日結束。
有關提名涵蓋選舉委員會五個界別的多個界別分組。今日接獲的提名資料稍後會上載到選舉網站。
選舉委員會將選出下任行政長官，界別分組一般選舉投票定於11月22日舉行。
